sentences.text: 3 . It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that the applicants are the husband and family members.
The non-bailable warrant order has been issued against the applicants.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that the ends of justice would be served in case the applicants are permitted to appear before the court concerned and apply for bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. for the State has no objection to the aforesaid prayer of the applicants.
5. In view of the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants, the applicants are directed to file surrender application before the court concerned on or before 3.4.2024.
The non-bailable warrant order issued against the applicants by the court concerned would be kept in abeyance till 3.4.2024.
The surrender application and the bail application would be filed together and the advance copy shall be served on the public prosecutor.
The court concerned shall decide the surrender application as well as the bail application of the applicants together within seven days.

6. In the event, the applicants do not surrender before the court concerned on or before 3.4.2024,
the court below would be at liberty to proceed in accordance with law.
7. With the aforesaid observation/direction, application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of.
